title: Implement explicit cross-place comparison
note: Native proposal validation, accepted merge and task completion remain separate required gates. This receipt does not mark the backlog complete.

artifacts/ is gitignored, so this receipt is on disk and is not part of git status. Its own sha256 is not stored inside this file.

WorldwideLegalSearchApp.tsx is outside the declared outputs, so this change does not mount the comparison in the shell. The shell root keeps data-compare closed. ComparePlaces renders its own .wwl root with data-compare open.
The component does not search. composePlaceComparison reads places, sources, coverage, and results the caller already has. It does not call a model, a backend, fetch, or a search function.

A place is compared only after a manual choice. Origin manual or manually selected counts. A suggestion, saved place, shared link, or device location stays out until the visitor chooses that candidate or confirms that place. Typing a name does not select it. A country code is not a place id.

One aligned date is the visitor's date when it is a real year, month, or day. Otherwise both recorded dates align at the coarser shared calendar label. Dates that do not share a label stay in their own columns. Dates and source revisions are not averaged. An invalid date does not change the aligned date.

Sources line up by source id. A source that exists in one place is absent in the other and is not copied across. Different pinned revisions stay different. A floating name such as latest is not a pinned revision and does not match another floating name.

Coverage lines up by level, including national, regional, and municipal. A missing municipal cell uses the catalog gap sentence. An unknown cell stays a different sentence. A gap is not filled from the other place. A counted zero is not a finding that no law exists. A coverage cell that names the other place is shown on that place.

Each result keeps the place id it names. A record whose place id and jurisdiction id disagree, a record with no place id, and a record for a place outside the comparison are held back and are not shown as either column's rule.

Contradictory local rules stay with their own places. Comparison does not merge them into one asserted answer and does not decide that a law applies. A supplied asserted answer or merged rule is refused and is not rendered. The same wording in both places remains two place-scoped rules.

Desktop and mobile columns use the existing stylesheet: .wwl-compare is one column below 64rem and two columns from 64rem. Jest jsdom does not apply that media query. The test checks the class, data-compare, and two column children.
Interface chrome is en, nl, ar, or ja. The municipal gap sentence comes from resultCopy. An Arabic interface sets dir rtl.
